bagPolicy.summary: Carver-Hawkeye Arena enforces a clear-bag policy and subjects all people and items to security screening. Small wristlets or clutches may be carried through the walk-through detector.
prohibited: Bags that do not meet the clear-bag policy
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Free public parking begins 90 minutes before tipoff in Lots 43NW, 43W, and 65. Free ADA parking is first come, first served in Lot 40 with a valid state-issued placard or plate.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published specific rideshare guidance on its official venue or guest-information pages.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession stands are cashless and accept credit or debit cards; stands open 90 minutes before competition. Beer, wine, and hard seltzer are sold, but outside alcohol is prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating is available through the Athletics Ticket Office, and free ADA parking is provided in Lot 40. Accessible sidewalks connect Lot 40 to the south entrance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Patrons may not exit and re-enter Carver-Hawkeye Arena.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will call is inside the north entrance lobby, and pickup requires photo ID. Media credential pickup is at the south entrance.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The north, west, east, and south entrances open 90 minutes before tipoff.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
